overview.title: Warm water in the desert edge
overview.p1: Asnaa (sometimes spelled Asmaa) is known for natural hot springs reachable on a short inland outing from Dakhla. It is a change of pace from the lagoon’s wind and open horizon.
overview.p2: Facilities are simple. Confirm current access and any local fees with your hotel or a driver before you go.
overview.p3: Combine with a wider desert loop if you have a full day and a 4x4.

faq.title: أسئلة شائعة حول ينابيع أسنى الساخنة

q1.question: How far are the springs?
q1.answer: A short inland drive from town — confirm the route with a local driver.

q2.question: Are they developed?
q2.answer: Expect simple natural pools, not a full spa resort.

q3.question: Entry fee?
q3.answer: May apply — check on the day.

q4.question: Worth it without kitesurf?
q4.answer: Yes if you want a quiet nature stop and have transport.

q5.question: What to bring?
q5.answer: Water, swimsuit, towel and sun protection.
